author: Nia Warfield
title: Your first trade for Wednesday, November 7
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Intel
Karen Finerman was a buyer of United Rentals
Steve Grasso was a buyer of Electronic Arts
Guy Adami was a buyer of Citigroup
